published_evidence.exploitation_evidence: The number of new generations of entities was calculated incorrectly and allowed infinite generations of entities to be created.
published_evidence.fix_strategy_evidence: Remove the operation that resets genMintCount.
published_evidence.root_cause_evidence: During generation switching, the current generation's counter genMintCount is reset, failing to accurately record the true minting quantity of the previous generation when the next generation begins.
